items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: Interviewer mentions Zutti was on the sides; Interviewee confirms 'she was on those sides' but does not describe a personal interaction or relationship with Zutti.

ctx.x: Well, yes, it was, I wonder, but they had other artists there. I think they had Count Basie and some others tied up with them. Well, those records made a hit and got acclaim anywhere they were heard, you know. George Haver wrote them up very enthusiastically, you know. And down there. Yeah.
I said, Zutti, Zutti was on those sides, you know.
Yeah, she was on those sides, that's right.
